this value is later used to index direction-to-vertex tables."},{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/h3/src/h3lib/lib/vertex.c","function":"vertexRotations","line":31,"var":"cell","code":"H3Error err = _h3ToFaceIjk(cell, &fijk);","note":"The attacker-controlled H3 index is converted into FaceIJK coordinates, propagating the input into face and base-cell selection logic."},{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/h3/src/h3lib/lib/vertex.c","function":"vertexRotations","line":42,"var":"baseCell","code":"int ccwRot60 = _baseCellToCCWrot60(baseCell, fijk.face);","note":"The derived base cell and face determine the rotation offset that controls later vertex-number mapping."},{"step":6,"file":"src-vul/h3/src/h3lib/lib/vertex.c","function":"vertexNumForDirection","line":113,"var":"directionToVertexNumHex[direction] / directionToVertexNumPent[direction]","code":"return (directionToVertexNumHex[direction] + NUM_HEX_VERTS - rotations) % NUM_HEX_VERTS;","note":"The computed rotation is applied to a fixed lookup table; if the upstream cell state is inconsistent, this table-driven mapping can produce an invalid vertex number that later drives the sink."},{"step":7,"file":"src-vul/h3/src/h3lib/lib/vertex.c","function":"cellToVertex","line":151,"var":"ownerVertexNum","code":"ownerVertexNum = vertexNum;","note":"The requested vertex number is carried forward as the candidate vertex index for the owning cell calculation."},{"step":8,"file":"src-vul/h3/src/h3lib/lib/vertex.c","function":"cellToVertex","line":166,"var":"ownerVertexNum","code":"ownerVertexNum = vertexNumForDirection(owner, direction);","note":"The vertex index is recomputed from the attacker-controlled cell geometry and can become inconsistent with the actual vertex layout."},{"step":9,"file":"src-vul/h3/src/h3lib/lib/vertex.c","function":"cellToVertex","line":214,"var":"out","code":"*out = vertexToH3(owner, ownerVertexNum);","note":"The final H3 vertex index is synthesized from the derived owner cell and vertex number, and this malformed vertex value is what the harness later feeds into vertexToLatLng/isValidVertex, reaching the memory-safety sink path."}]
